title: Causal Structure of Spacetime Singularities and Their Observable Signatures
summary: We analyze the causal structure of horizonless compact objects via the light-cone geometry and conformal compactification of the Joshi-Malafarina-Narayan (JMN-1) and Janis-Newman-Winicour (JNW) spacetimes. Penrose diagrams reveal that JMN-1 undergoes a transition from timelike $(0<M_0<2/3)$ to null $(2/3<M_0<4/5)$ singularities, while JNW remains timelike throughout, in contrast to the spacelike singularity of the Schwarzschild spacetime.
